set.body: Outcome: qualified nonlinear MNI152NLin6Asym and MNI152NLin2009cAsym transforms distributed as immutable artifacts and usable through neuroatlas. Scope: offline Nibi build and qualification; verified resolver/cache; one-pass scalar/label/probability application; atlas metadata; tests/docs. Non-goals: runtime fitting, subjects, surface mapping, all-pairs support. Invariants: preserve existing map_atlas values API; planned routes remain non-executable until qualified artifacts and live bytes verified; fixed thresholds before candidate evaluation; ANTs independent oracle; no large binaries in git. Evidence: focused synthetic and real-H5 direction/grid/label/probability tests, frozen scientific policy and provenance, reviewed visual report, package tests/check, anonymous asset download. Next: reconcile Nibi state and implement bounded runtime and qualification gaps.
set.title: Complete V1 MNI template transforms in neuroatlas
